Mauterndorf – Grosseck-Speiereck's family reputation is well earned: dedicated beginner areas, a well-organised childcare service, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. Mauterndorf – Grosseck-Speiereck's altitude (1095 m at the bottom, 2400 m at the top) helps it keep decent snow cover in mid-winter. January and February are the most reliable months; in December and March, it is best to check conditions before finalising a booking. The budget for a stay in Mauterndorf – Grosseck-Speiereck is clearly high: 61€ for a day lift pass, on top of which come accommodation and mountain restaurants among the most expensive in the Alps. A Northern Alps resort that should suit most skier profiles without disappointing.
